Recorded claim:
The 2024 archive-options migration added a Python recipe named bug_697706_archive_options.py. It COPYs each old DTD entity into the new mail/messenger/preferences/am-archiveoptions.ftl target, including labels and access keys. The new en-US FTL alone would not migrate localized strings from old language packs. The recipe was later removed from the current tree after migration work, so this is historical migration practice, not a current file that should be edited. D208387 received a separate Fluent migration review before landing.

Provenance: 263f810ee688d7f39111173ac2e9acdb148eee59b68bc56029bac0cc3f7229de. Original evidence IDs: 045a2e270d76c9b8cf16fc52903da1cf1713444832591037aad19196e5f36fdb, 89d25bb8c79382dc832d30cd6badcc39c3594be1b75b9ee9f5534afd6cd371d9, c8d28c347b37674c09fa53c0f02996bc45e4c42d91e82e77cf8cfc452a92d302.
This is a recorded historical interpretation, not independent source verification. Source quotes from personal imports or unconfirmed-access records remain private. Historical test results are reported outcomes; no tests were rerun for this backfill.
